body:
Closes #1972 (the coupler half).

When `dt_atmos < Δt_cpl`, the atmosphere takes several steps per coupling step, so we have to average over the coupling step to conserve water. 

Summary of changes:
- `Interfacer.step!(sim::ClimaAtmosSimulation, t)` steps the atmosphere to `t` and stores in `sim.precipitation` the mean surface rain and snow fluxes over the steps taken. `get_field` for `:liquid_precipitation` and `:snow_precipitation` returns these means.
- The step count moves into `Interfacer.n_steps_until(sim, t)`, which the generic `step!` and the atmosphere method share. It replaces the two generic `step!` methods with one.
- A new unit test (not sure if necessary?)

Note: `sim.precipitation` is not checkpointed, but I think this will only matter if `dt_atmos > Δt_cpl`.
title: Average ClimaAtmos precip over coupling step
